$comment: Plain words for the 'What we found' lines of the visit summary (docs/plans/visit-story-v2-offers-design.md, section 1.1). 'chart' maps a chart finding recorded today without a procedure; 'needs_treatment' is a tooth given that health level today; 'icd10' and 'icd11' map a coded condition recorded today by its code or the longest matching prefix (K02 covers K02.1). Free text (condition names, notes) is never read. A code that is not here gives no line. English only; reviewed by: pending (founder).
